description: This plugin adds commands and a GUI for dimension travel and enables player teleportation via names or selectors.
body:
# DimensionTP

This plugin adds commands and a GUI for dimension travel and enables player teleportation via names or selectors. 

While designed for administrators, it can be granted to regular players by configuring permissions with tools like LuckPerms.

---

## Features

- **Admin GUI / Commands** — Accessible via command line, command blocks, or the GUI.
- **Multiple Profiles** — Up to 5 profiles per player (configurable). Each profile stores inventory, ender chest, health, hunger, XP, and game mode independently.
- **Per-player Permission System** — Disabled by default. Admins can grant access individually via LuckPerms.
- **Admin Detection** — Based on OP level (default: 4) and a UUID whitelist.
- **Language Support** — Supports English and Japanese (automatic switching).

---

## Quick Start
```bash
# Help(dimtp.use default true)
/dimtp
/dimtp help

# Teleports the specified player to the specified dimension(dimtp.others + dimtp.admin.world.<dim>)
/dimtp <player> <dimensionName>

# Teleports yourself to the specified dimension(dimtp.self + dimtp.world.<dim>)
/dimtp <dimensionName> 

# Opens the GUI for general users (dimtp.gui.personal)
/dimtp gui

# Opens the management GUI for administrators(dimtp.gui.admin)
/dimtp admin

# ReloadPlugin(dimtp.reload)
/dimtp reload

# KeepPositon
/dimtp *** *** keep
```
